## Appearance

Stacy has fair, curly hair that has been described as lovely. She is also noted for having fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural ability to win over and maintain the affection of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Stacy previously taught school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she maintained perfect order without ever whipping her pupils. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school under Miss Stacy's guidance and thrived. At the end of the school term, Miss Stacy delighted her students by confirming that she would return to teach the Queen's class the following year.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a supportive teacher and mentor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), guiding her academic growth and encouraging her school pursuits. Under Miss Stacy's instruction, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) thrives at school and earns top honors on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) views her teacher as a true, helpful friend, and eagerly anticipates continuing her education in Miss Stacy's Queen's class.
